title: Equipment Rental and Demo: Day Rates, Weekly Blocks and Season Lease Prices
content:
## Rate card: Equipment Rental and Demo

The prices below are the collective's rates for the six packages of the Equipment Rental and Demo line. Each package carries its own shop day rate, its own multi-day day rate, the number of rental days at which that multi-day rate replaces the shop rate, the price of a full seven-day block, the price of holding the package for the whole season under a lease, and the point at which the agreement value is collected.

| Package | Shop day rate, one rider | Multi-day day rate | Multi-day threshold, rental days | Full seven-day block | Season lease price | Value collected |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 32.00 USD | 27.00 USD | 3 | 169.00 USD | 279.00 USD | at collection |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 46.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 3 | 245.00 USD | 389.00 USD | at collection |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 62.00 USD | 53.00 USD | 3 | 329.00 USD | 519.00 USD | at booking |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 79.00 USD | 68.00 USD | 3 | 419.00 USD | 669.00 USD | at booking |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 95.00 USD | 82.00 USD | 2 | 509.00 USD | 829.00 USD | at booking |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 1 | 0.00 USD | 449.00 USD | at booking |

### What each column is

1. **Shop day rate, one rider.** The price in USD of one day of the package for one rider at the shop rate.
2. **Multi-day day rate.** The price in USD per day of the package when the agreement runs for the multi-day term.
3. **Multi-day threshold.** The number of rental days at which the multi-day day rate replaces the shop day rate.
4. **Full seven-day block.** The price in USD of a full seven-day block of the package.
5. **Season lease price.** The price in USD of holding the package for the whole season under a lease rather than by the day.
6. **Value collected.** When the agreement value is collected: at booking, at collection, or at hand-in.

### The same figures read across the line

The Season-Long Lease Package is the one package of the line that carries no day money of its own: its shop day rate, its multi-day day rate and its seven-day block all stand at 0.00 USD, and 449.00 USD is the price of holding it for the season. Every other package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line carries a multi-day day rate below its own shop day rate, and the gap widens up the line, from 5.00 USD a day on the Junior Ski & Board Rental to 13.00 USD a day on the Demo Ski & Board Rental. The multi-day threshold stands at 3 rental days for the Junior, Basic, Sport and Performance packages, at 2 for the Demo package and at 1 for the Season-Long Lease Package.

### Points of judgement on this card

**On which figure a season lease is priced from.** The Season-Long Lease Package is priced from its season lease price of 449.00 USD. Every other package of the line also carries a season lease price against its name — 279.00 USD, 389.00 USD, 519.00 USD, 669.00 USD and 829.00 USD from the Junior package up to the Demo package — being the price of holding that package for the whole season rather than by the day.

**On the point of collection.** The Junior Ski & Board Rental and the Basic Ski & Board Rental are collected at collection; the Sport, Performance, Demo and Season-Long Lease packages are collected at booking.
